# Install and use document search MCP

Last updated on 2025-07-01

This article introduces how to install and use the document search MCP tool within AI tools (use [Trae](https://www.trae.ai/) as an example).

## Preparations

### Install Node.js

Before using the MCP tool, you need to install Node.js in the environment where the AI tool is running.

Please ensure that the installed Node version is higher than v18.20.8. It is recommended to use the latest version provided by the [Node.js official website](https://nodejs.org/).

- **Install Node.js on macOS**

  After installation, run the following commands to check if the installation was successful.

  ```
  node -vnpm -v
  ```

  If successful, the corresponding version numbers will be returned.
  - Method 1 (Recommended): Use Homebrew to install

    ```
    brew install node
    ```
  - Method 2: Use the Node.js official installer
    1. Visit the [Node.js official website](https://nodejs.org/).
    2. Download and install the LTS version.
- **Install Node.js on Windows**
  - Method 1: Use the Node.js official installer
    1. Visit the [Node.js official website](https://nodejs.org/).
    2. Download and run the Windows installer (.msi file).
    3. Follow the installation wizard to complete the installation.
  - Method 2: Use nvm-windows to install

    After installation, run the following commands to check if the installation was successful.

    ```
    node -vnpm -v
    ```

    If successful, the corresponding version numbers will be returned.
    1. Download [nvm-windows](https://github.com/coreybutler/nvm-windows/releases).
    2. Install nvm-windows.
    3. Use nvm to install Node.js:

       ```
       nvm install latestnvm use <version>
       ```

### Install lark-mcp tool

lark-mcp is an MCP toolkit provided by the Lark Open Platform. You need to install lark-mcp (version 0.3.0 or higher) before using the document search MCP tool.

1. Open the command line in the Trae environment and execute the following command to globally install the lark-mcp tool.

   - You can open the Terminal in Trae to execute the command, or you can open the command line of the operating system where Trae is located to execute the command. There is no difference between the two.
   - The following command installs the latest version of lark-mcp by default. If your previously installed lark-mcp version is lower than 0.3.0, you need to re-execute the command to install the latest version of lark-mcp.

   ```
   npm install -g @larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp
   ```
2. After installation, execute the following command to check the installation status.

   ```
   lark-mcp -V
   ```

   If successful, the version number of the tool will be returned.

## Install document search MCP

Add MCP Server and install document search MCP tool in the AI tool (use [Trae](https://www.trae.ai/) as an example).

Some AI tools support one-click installation via URL, for example: [![Install MCP Server](https://cursor.com/deeplink/mcp-install-dark.svg?height=28&lazyload=true&width=126)](cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/mcp/install?name=lark_open_doc_search&config=eyJjb21tYW5kIjoibnB4IiwiYXJncyI6WyIteSIsIkBsYXJrc3VpdGVvYXBpL2xhcmstbWNwIiwicmVjYWxsLWRldmVsb3Blci1kb2N1bWVudHMiXX0=)

1. Open the Trae tool.
2. Click the **Toggle AI Side Bar** icon in the upper right corner of the interface.
3. In the AI Sidebar's **AI management**, click **MCP**.
4. In the **MCP** interface, click **Add MCP Server**.
5. Click **Configure Manually**.
6. In the **Configure Manually** input box, replace the default content with the following content, and click **Confirm**.

   ```
   {  "mcpServers": {    "lark_open_doc_search": {      "command": "npx",      "args": [        "-y",        "@larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp",        "recall-developer-documents"      ]    }  }}
   ```
7. The system will prompt that the MCP tool has been automatically added to **@Builder with MCP**. Click **Got it**.

   After configuration is complete, you can view the MCP tool (named lark_open_doc_search) on the **MCP Servers** page.

## Use the document search MCP

This chapter introduces the steps and example effects of using the document search MCP tool in the AI tool (use [Trae](https://www.trae.ai/) as an example).

1. Open **Trae** on the right side of the Trae tool.
2. Click **Agent** at the lower left corner of the input box, and select the intelligent agent where lark_open_doc_search tool is located (default is **Builder with MCP**).
3. In the lower right corner of the input box, select an appropriate model (the performance varies among different models).
4. Fill in the scenario prompt in the input box and click the send button at the lower right corner of the input box.

   For example, send a prompt like `How to create a Lark card and send it to a specific user?`, and the MCP tool will retrieve relevant Lark Open Platform documents and generate sample code.

   The scenario prompt should be as detailed as possible, and some limiting conditions should be added appropriately to ensure the model can run accurately. For example, if you need the large model to directly return Lark Open Platform document links, add conditions like `search documents`, `provide document access links` in the prompt.
   - In area ① of the image below, you can view the access link and content of the retrieved documentation in the response results of the Documentation Retrieval MCP tool.
   - In area ② of the image below, the large model will generate the corresponding example code based on the retrieval results of the MCP tool.
